field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Adds the tag and the ecommerce events to the storefront. Default: No.

field.label: Tag Type
field.comment: Google Tag Manager: events go to the dataLayer for your GTM tags (use the GTM Container Export to set them up). gtag.js: events are sent straight to GA4.

field.label: GTM Container ID
field.comment: For example GTM-AB12CDE. Find it at the top of your Google Tag Manager workspace.

field.label: GTM Script Domain
field.comment: Change only for server-side tagging (for example https://sgtm.example.com). Default: https://www.googletagmanager.com

field.label: GA4 Measurement ID
field.comment: For example G-AB12CD34EF (GA4 Admin > Data streams). Required for gtag.js and refunds; also written into the GTM container export.

field.label: Additional Google Tag IDs
field.comment: Comma-separated, for example AW-123456789 for Google Ads. Each ID is configured after the GA4 measurement ID, so the Google Ads conversion linker can store the ad click (only when ad_storage consent is granted). Ecommerce events still go to GA4 only; no Google Ads conversion events are added. Allowed: G-, AW-, DC- and GT- IDs. Default: empty.

field.label: Load Tags
field.comment: Default: Immediately, with Google Consent Mode (recommended). The other options need CommerceGears Cookie Consent and load GTM or gtag.js only after the visitor accepts that category; they are ignored when Cookie Consent is disabled.

field.label: Consent Mode Defaults (Without CommerceGears Cookie Consent)
field.comment: Only used when CommerceGears Cookie Consent is not enabled. Choose "Denied" if another consent tool sends gtag('consent', 'update', ...) but does not set the defaults itself.

field.label: Debug Mode
field.comment: Logs every event to the browser console and adds debug_mode so events show in GA4 DebugView. Switch off on live stores.

field.label: Item ID
field.comment: Use the same identifier as your Google Merchant Center feed. Configurable products report the parent; the chosen variant SKU goes into item_variant.

field.label: Brand Attribute
field.comment: Product attribute for item_brand. Default: Manufacturer.

field.label: Default Brand
field.comment: Used when the product has no brand value. Leave empty to omit item_brand.

field.label: Item Categories
field.comment: item_category to item_category5 from the category tree (root category excluded).

field.label: Affiliation
field.comment: Sent with purchases and items. Empty uses the store view name.

field.label: Currency
field.comment: Currency of value, price and tax in all events. Default: the currency the customer sees.

field.label: Item Prices Include Tax
field.comment: Item prices in events include tax. Default: No.

field.label: Purchase Value Includes Tax
field.comment: The value is the order grand total after discounts; No leaves tax out (net revenue). Tax is always sent separately in the tax parameter as well. Default: Yes.

field.label: Purchase Value Includes Shipping
field.comment: Shipping is always sent separately in the shipping parameter as well. Default: Yes.

field.label: Maximum Items per view_item_list
field.comment: Keeps the dataLayer small on long category pages. Default: 50; GA4 accepts up to 200 items per event.

field.label: Skip Zero-value Orders
field.comment: No purchase event for orders whose purchase value is 0 (for example free products). Such orders are still marked as handled, so they are never sent later. Default: No.

field.label: Enhanced Conversions (user_data)
field.comment: Adds SHA-256 hashed email, phone, name and street (plus city, region, postcode and country) as user_data to purchase, sign_up and login. With CommerceGears Cookie Consent it is only set after the visitor accepts the category for ad_user_data (Marketing). Only enable if your privacy policy covers it. Default: No.

group.label: Refunds (Measurement Protocol)
group.comment: Credit memos are sent to GA4 as refund events from the server by cron, in the background. Uses the GA4 Measurement ID above.

field.label: Send Refunds
field.comment: Sends a refund event for every credit memo. Needs the GA4 Measurement ID and an API secret. Default: No.

field.label: API Secret
field.comment: GA4 Admin > Data streams > your web stream > Measurement Protocol API secrets. Stored encrypted.
